title: Emit resumable_job metrics from KubernetesPodOperator
decision: The phase decides the counter, not the cleanup - emit already_succeeded and terminal_resubmit from the pod phase before process_pod_deletion runs
why: to avoid making the counter depend on is_delete_operator_pod, which is a cleanup setting rather than a resume decision
quote: Emitting after would make the counter depend on `is_delete_operator_pod`, which is a cleanup setting rather than a resume decision.
